an3.100:1.2: yathā yathāyaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā taṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī ti -- evaṃ santaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyavāso na hoti okāso na paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.
an3.100:1.3: Yo ca kho bhikkhave evaṃ vadeyya --
an3.100:1.4: yathā yathā vedanīyaṃ ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathāssa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī ti -evaṃ santaṃ bhikkhave brahmacariyavāso hoti okāso paññāyati sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya.
an3.100:1.5: Idha bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa appamattakam pi pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ tam enaṃ nirayaṃ upaneti.
an3.100:1.6: Idha pana bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva appamattakaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ diṭṭhadhamme c' eva vedanīyaṃ hoti nāṇu pi khāyati <kiṃ> bahud eva? 2.
an3.100:2.1: Kathaṃrūpassa bhikkhave puggalassa appamattakam pi pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ tam enaṃ nirayaṃ upaneti?
an3.100:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo abhāvitakāyo hoti abhāvitasīlo abhāvitacitto abhāvitapañño paritto appātumo appadukkhavihārī.
an3.100:2.3: Evarūpassa bhikkhave puggalassa appamattakam pi pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ tam enaṃ nirayaṃ upaneti.
an3.100:3.1: Kathaṃrūpassa bhikkhave puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva appamattakaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti nāṇu pi khāyati <kiṃ> bahud eva?
an3.100:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo bhāvitakāyo hoti bhāvitasīlo bhāvitacitto bhāvitapañño aparitto mahattā appamāṇavihārī.
an3.100:3.3: Evarūpassa bhikkhave puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva appamattakaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti nāṇu pi khāyati <kiṃ> bahud eva? 3.
an3.100:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso loṇaphalaṃ paritte udakamallake pakkhipeyya.
an3.100:4.3: Api nu taṃ parittaṃ udakamallake udakaṃ amunā loṇaphalena loṇaṃ assa apeyyan ti?
an3.100:4.6: Aduṃ hi bhante parittaṃ udakamallake udakaṃ. Taṃ amunā loṇaphalena loṇam assa apeyyan ti.
an3.100:4.7: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso loṇaphalaṃ Gaṅgāya nadiyā pakkhipeyya.
an3.100:4.9: Api nu sā Gaṅgā nadī amunā loṇaphalena loṇaṃ assa apeyyā ti?
an3.100:4.12: Asu hi bhante Gaṅgāya nadiyā mahā udakakkhandho. So amunā loṇaphalena <na> loṇo assa apeyyo ti. Evam
an3.100:5.1: eva kho bhikkhave idh' ekaccassa puggalassa appamattakam pi pāpaṃ kataṃ tam enaṃ nirayaṃ upaneti.
an3.100:5.2: Idha pana bhikkhave ekaccassa puggalassa tādisaṃ yeva appamattakaṃ pāpaṃ kammaṃ kataṃ diṭṭhadhammavedanīyaṃ hoti nāṇu pi khāyati <kiṃ> bahud eva? 4.

an3.100:13.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave orabbhiko vā urabbhaghātako vā appekaccaṃ urabbhaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyamānaṃ pahoti hantuṃ vā bandhituṃ vā jhāpetuṃ vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā kātuṃ, appekaccaṃ urabbhaṃ adinnaṃ ādiyamānaṃ nappahoti hantuṃ vā bandhituṃ vā jhāpetuṃ vā yathāpaccayaṃ vā kātuṃ.
